answer: Give every identity two keys: a hot key for daily work and a cold key kept offline. Each epoch, inside a two-hour window, the cold key must sign a fresh authorization, or pending rewards freeze and standing resets. A farm of 1,000 fake identities needs 1,000 separate cold keys and 1,000 signing ceremonies in that window, because one wallet cannot sign for the others. Over a longer horizon, that per-identity ceremony repeats every epoch, so a farm cannot hide in an oasis of cheap copies or grow a vine of fake accounts from a single custody setup.
